name: unreal_forums_jobs-jobs-mcp
display_name: Unreal Engine forums: Job Offerings MCP
description: Unreal Engine forums: Job Offerings (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented end

tools.name: search
tools.description: The forum runs Discourse, whose public API (https://docs.discourse.org) serves GET /search.json?q=… without a key for public categories. The query is scoped to the Job Offerings category with Discourse's '#<category>' option ('#got-skills-looking-for-talent:job-offerings', category id 76) and ordered newest first ('order:latest'); page pages the results (Discourse returns up to 50 per page and sets grouped_search_result.more_full_page_results when there are more). Postings are community forum topics (paid, royalty and unpaid offers mixed; the title usually carries a [PAID]/[UNPAID] tag), id is the topic id (use it with get_posting), and the topic URL is https://forums.unrealengine.com/t/{slug}/{id}. Matching posts' blurbs and authors are in the response's posts[] (not mapped). Keep polling gentle; this is a community forum.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /t/{id}.json 'Get a single topic'; description is the opening post's HTML (post_stream.posts[0].cooked, where the poster describes the role and how to contact them); slug, category_id, tags and the reply posts are in raw.
